description.description: What the artifact is for, in a sentence.

html.description: The artifact as one self-contained HTML fragment: inline <style> and <script>, inline SVG, data: images. No external URLs, scripts, iframes, forms or network calls — it is refused otherwise. It runs in a sandboxed frame with no network and no access to the app.

height.description: How tall it shows, in CSS pixels, where a doc embeds it. 420 when not set.

snapshot.description: A still of the artifact for pages that run no script — a shared doc, an export. Written by the gateway: status, at, bytes, error.

sources.description: Object ids the artifact was made from — a doc, dashboard, metric.
